findings.message: "#moment-3" has CSS `transform: scale(0) rotate(3deg)` and a GSAP tween animates scale. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: scale(0) rotate(3deg)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: scale: 0. Example: tl.fromTo('#moment-3', { scale: 0 }, { scale: 0, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: ".dragged-card" has CSS `transform: scale(0.9)` and a GSAP tween animates x/y/scale. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: scale(0.9)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: scale: 0.9. Example: tl.fromTo('.dragged-card', { scale: 0.9 }, { scale: 0.9, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: ".stamped-cards" has CSS `transform: translate(-50%, -50%)` and a GSAP tween animates y. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translate(-50%, -50%)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50. Example: tl.fromTo('.stamped-cards', { xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50 }, { xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: ".checkmark" has CSS `transform: scale(0)` and a GSAP tween animates scale. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: scale(0)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: scale: 0. Example: tl.fromTo('.checkmark', { scale: 0 }, { scale: 0, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.
